title: Murder Suspect Details 11-Year-Old Boy’s Killing at Baseball Game
description:
An 11-year-old was shot and killed while leaving an Isotopes baseball game in Albuquerque, New Mexico on September 6, 2023. Daniel Gomez, 26, came forward to investigators saying his friends Nathan Garley, 21, and Jose Romero, 22, noticed a rival gang member, and things escalated from there. When the trio left they allegedly tracked down the truck they believed belonged to the rival gang when one of the men shot 14 rounds into the truck killing an 11-year-old and paralyzing the young boy’s cousin. The case of mistaken identity left the trio facing murder charges. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
